shortDescription: Gathers information about VPLEX Storage details

options.name: debug
options.description: To specify whether to have debug statements from vplexapi in log file or not

options.name: filters
options.description: List of filters to support filtered output for storage entities. Each filter is a list of {filter_key, filter_operator, filter_value}. Supports passing of multiple filters.

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: List of string variables to specify the VPLEX entities for which information is required. stor_array - storage array stor_vol - storage volumes stor_view - storage views port - ports initiator - initiators virt_vol - virtual volumes cg - consistency groups device - devices extent - extents dist_device - distributed devices dist_cg - distributed consistency groups dist_virt_vol - distributed virtual volumes amp - array management providers be_port - back end ports device_mig_job - device migratio

options.name: ssl_ca_cert
options.description: SSL CA certificate file (.pem format) provided by the user to verify SSL

options.name: verifycert
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. True - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. False - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vplex_timeout
options.description: the network connectivity timeout value to connect to VPLEX host in seconds

options.name: vplexhost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the VPLEX host

options.name: vplexpassword
options.description: the password of the VPLEX host.
